description:
Join Cornucopias' Co-CEOs Rob Greig and Josh Jones in the latest episode of Copi Cafe. From their favorite beverages to gaming insights, graphics cards, marketing strategies, a special OG appearance by Simba, and a fire leak, this episode is absolutley Corntastic!

While efforts have been made to ensure accuracy, errors or inaccuracies may be present. Cornucopias suggests consulting a professional for advice. The Company, its employees, and owners are not liable for errors, omissions, or any consequences from not seeking proper financial advice

00:00 Beverage Choices
03:16 Game News
14:59 Graphics Cards
21:17 Marketing Strategy
29:00 Conferences
30:02 Simba OG Appearance
42:33 Leak! 
48:12 Community Questions

Cornucopias is an MMORPG Metaverse game accessible through multiple platforms and created on Unreal Engine 5. 

The vision is to bring freedom, power, autonomy and new economics to the player. 

Our ambition is to create a cutting-edge metaverse experience through immersive gameplay, an exciting story, exceptional artwork and innovative economics.

The Cornucopias Metaverse is a network of floating bubbles and domes, each with diverse themes and characteristics. Here, players of all ages can engage in a series of mini-games and explore vast landscapes in search of precious resources which can be crafted into valuable items.
